name: uams-web/arresearch
description: A child theme for ARResearch.org, based on the Minimum Pro child theme.

scripts.mutate: @php -d pcov.directory=. -d 'pcov.exclude=~/(vendor|tests)/~' vendor/bin/pest tests/Unit/AtLoadTest.php tests/Unit/CustomizerTest.php tests/Unit/FunctionsTest.php tests/Unit/TemplateArchivePortfolioTest.php tests/Unit/TemplateFrontPageTest.php tests/Unit/TemplateLandingTest.php tests/Unit/TemplateSinglePortfolioTest.php tests/Unit/ThemeDefaultsTest.php --mutate --path=functions.php,lib,archive-portfolio.php,front-page.php,page_landing.php,single-portfolio.php

scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the Pest suite that needs no WordPress and no database.
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan at the configured level.
scripts-descriptions.test:pint: Check formatting with Pint without changing files.
